document: Alone Against the Tide Solitaire Adventure by The Lakeshore (Call of Cthulhu MPRG 23174) (Nicholas Johnson, Lynne Hardy, Mike Mason etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You take a step toward the man. He hears your approach and 
rounds on you, swinging wildly with a shout of surprise.

His fist catches you in the chest and sends you sprawling 
backward. He throws himself on top of you, landing blow after 
blow with his fists. You raise your arms to fend off the worst of 
his fury as he works you over. Amid the confusion, you glance 
up to see the monk running out of the room.

Finally, the man in the suit grabs you by the collar and begins 
slamming you violently against the floor. It takes only a few 
such blows before you lose consciousness.
